hero.title: Build Your Business Through EPEW
hero.description: Every successful business begins with an idea. EPEW develops entrepreneurs through a coordinated Entrepreneur Development Ecosystem that transforms ideas into successful businesses.

dream.title: Every Great Business Begins With One Idea
dream.paragraph1: Your idea has the potential to transform your future, create jobs, strengthen your family, and improve your community.
dream.paragraph2: At EPEW, we believe entrepreneurs are developed—not simply funded. Through preparation, professional guidance, coordinated support, and the Entrepreneur Development Ecosystem, ideas become successful businesses.

funding.title: Preparation Comes Before Funding
funding.description: EPEW prepares entrepreneurs first. When entrepreneurs become business-ready, EPEW connects them with the funding needed to launch and grow successful businesses.

developmentModel.title: The Official EPEW Entrepreneur Development Model
developmentModel.description: EPEW follows a structured entrepreneur development model that prepares entrepreneurs, coordinates professional support, connects funding, and strengthens businesses through the Entrepreneur Development Ecosystem.

step1.title: The Entrepreneur Brings the Idea
step1.text: Every successful business begins with an idea. The entrepreneur brings the vision, passion, determination, and commitment to build something meaningful.

step2.title: EPEW Develops the Idea
step2.text: EPEW transforms the idea into a structured business opportunity through education, coaching, planning, professional guidance, and business development.

step3.title: EPEW Prepares the Entrepreneur
step3.text: Entrepreneurs receive the preparation, knowledge, coaching, and guidance needed to become business-ready and funding-ready.

step4.title: EPEW Connects the Entrepreneur with Funding
step4.text: Once entrepreneurs are prepared, EPEW connects them with the funding needed to launch and grow their businesses.

step5.title: EPEW Provides the Entrepreneur Development Ecosystem (EDE)
step5.text: The Entrepreneur Development Ecosystem brings together coaches, professional teams, Founding Supporters, Certified Growth Partners, intelligent technology, and coordinated resources into one complete support system.

step6.title: EPEW Helps You Open Your Business
step6.text: EPEW coordinates the professional services, launch preparation, business opening, promotion, and grand opening so entrepreneurs begin operations with confidence.

step7.title: IBOS Coordinates the Journey
step7.text: The Intelligent Business Operating System coordinates every stage of entrepreneur development by managing workflows, communications, service requests, milestones, progress tracking, business readiness, funding readiness, and long-term business operations.

step8.title: EPEW Helps Strengthen Your Business
step8.text: Entrepreneurship does not end at opening day. EPEW continues supporting entrepreneurs through coaching, professional services, quarterly reporting, promotion, intelligent technology, and long-term business growth.

ecosystem.title: You Are Supported by a Complete Ecosystem
ecosystem.paragraph1: From the moment you are approved, you become part of a coordinated Entrepreneur Development Ecosystem dedicated to helping your business succeed.
ecosystem.paragraph2: The ecosystem brings together coaching, professional support, Founding Supporters, Certified Growth Partners, digital tools, funding readiness, and long-term business growth.

coach.title: Dedicated Coach
coach.text: Your coach guides your development journey and helps coordinate the support you need.

teams.title: Professional Teams
teams.text: Professional teams support business formation, branding, promotion, planning, and launch preparation.

digital.title: Digital Business Presence
digital.text: Every approved entrepreneur receives a permanent public Business Welcome Page.

supporters.title: Founding Supporters
supporters.text: Build a community of people who believe in your vision and want to support your business story.

partners.title: Certified Growth Partners
partners.text: Access specialized expertise through partners that strengthen your business development.

ibos.title: IBOS Coordination
ibos.text: IBOS coordinates workflows, milestones, service requests, communications, and funding readiness.

coachGuided.title: Coach-Guided Development
coachGuided.description: Your assigned coach serves as your primary guide throughout your entrepreneur journey. The coach helps you prepare, organize, understand expectations, and connect with the support needed to move forward.
coachGuided.validationDescription: Every entrepreneur follows a structured preparation and validation process before entering the funding queue. This helps ensure business readiness, accountability, and long-term success.
coachGuided.validationRule: No entrepreneur enters the funding process without completing the EPEW preparation journey.

leader.title: You Remain the Leader
leader.notRun: EPEW does not run your business.
leader.ecosystem: EPEW provides the ecosystem that helps your business succeed.

journey.title: Your Entrepreneur Journey
journey.description: EPEW helps entrepreneurs move from idea to preparation, from preparation to funding readiness, and from launch to long-term growth.

prepare.title: Prepare
prepare.text: Develop your business and complete preparation.

funding.title: Funding
funding.text: Become funding-ready and enter the queue.

launch.title: Launch
launch.text: Open and begin growing your business.

promise.title: The Official EPEW Promise
promise.line4: We help you get the funding needed to launch your business.
promise.description: Together, we build successful businesses, strengthen communities, and create lasting wealth.

cta.title: Start Your Entrepreneur Journey
cta.description: Your business idea is the beginning. EPEW provides the ecosystem to help transform it into a successful business.
